title: Video Generation Models: A Survey of Post-Training and Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2610.00812v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Video generation has rapidly progressed from short, low-quality clips to high-resolution, long-duration sequences with complex spatiotemporal dynamics. Despite strong generative priors learned through large-scale pretraining, pretrained video models often fail to reliably follow human intent, maintain temporal coherence, or satisfy physical and safety constraints. Compared with image and text generation, alignment in video generation presents unique challenges, including error accumulation over time, motion-appearance coupling, multi-objective trade-offs, and limited supervision for temporal properties. These challenges motivate systematic post-training strategies that adapt pretrained models without retraining them from scratch. In this survey, we present the first comprehensive review of post-training and alignment in video generation models. translated_title: 视频生成模型：后训练与对齐综述
translated_abstract: 视频生成技术已从短小、低质量的片段迅速发展到具备复杂时空动态的高分辨率、长时长序列。尽管通过大规模预训练学习到了强大的生成先验，预训练视频模型往往无法可靠地遵循人类意图、保持时间连贯性，或满足物理与安全约束。与图像和文本生成相比，视频生成中的对齐面临独特的挑战，包括误差随时间累积、运动与外观的耦合、多目标权衡，以及时间属性监督数据的匮乏。这些挑战促使研究者采用系统性的后训练策略，在不从头重新训练的前提下适配预训练模型。在本综述中，我们首次对视频生成模型的后训练与对齐进行了全面回顾。我们将后训练构建为一个统一框架，并区分了隐式对齐与（显式对齐）……
tldr: 本文是首个对视频生成模型的后训练与对齐技术进行全面综述的工作，提出了统一的后训练框架，以应对误差累积、运动-外观耦合等视频对齐所特有的挑战。
en_tdlr: This is the first comprehensive survey of post-training and alignment in video generation models, presenting a unified post-training framework to address video-specific alignment challenges such as error accumulation and motion-appearance coupling.
